status: descriptive only; not performance acceptance, rebaseline, quiet-host qualification, or SDK policy qualification
bandsAre: investigation thresholds, not permitted degradation or acceptance criteria

method.hostPolicy: Observed host activity is included per study. Quiet-host status is copied only from the verified observer field; this projection makes no exclusive lease, GPU isolation, or physical isolation claim.
method.pairedStatistic: Each row preserves the twelve independent log effects and exact paired estimate, raw p-value, Holm-adjusted p-value, control-stability flag, and observed maximum repeat drift. Medians are descriptive.

sourceAndArtifactBinding.candidateBuildArtifactEquivalence: The 138a648 candidate code artifacts match the fully runtime-tested fa492ab artifacts across all six profiles; the source difference is documentation-only. This proves binary continuity, not a new runtime test.
sourceAndArtifactBinding.sourceProtocol: The original-UI baseline follows PR10 base f819 through SDK/common-harness overlays. The starting-redesign lineage follows a docs-only continuation from PR11 base c745, then SDK/common-harness overlays. These are distinct lineages and are not collapsed.

verdict.status: Review-required; no acceptance or rebaseline claim
verdict.dispositionsAreRetained: All original improved, regressed, and no-resolved-change classifications are retained per row; no flag is suppressed by aggregation.
verdict.sameBinaryControls: All four AA/AB study controls and their individual per-row stability flags are preserved.
verdict.sdkPolicy: SDK measured-base policy remains unqualified unless independently closed by its owner.
verdict.performanceAdvice: Open; a projection cannot close owner advice or host-qualification policy.

excludedHistoricalComparison.note: Historical cohort only; not the current candidate or current SDK comparison and not pooled into these results.

projectionExclusions: Private absolute paths, usernames, hostnames, foreground window/process identities, and raw observer names.
Raw native process receipts and slot records; twelve derived block log-effects are retained for reproducibility without process identity.
Executable images, symbols, compiler traces, and raw toolchain/dependency manifests; their SHA-256 bindings are retained.
No missing metric, audit field, host observation, source identity, or hash is represented as zero.
